CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apiosk_normalize_api_category()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'gateway_v2', 'kyb', 'providers', 'catalog', 'actions', 'billing', 'agents', 'wallets', 'research', 'integrations', 'observability', 'support', 'content', 'operations', 'identity', 'extensions', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.category IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  -- Bijective with the reverse map in provider-portal/src/lib/apis-db.ts
  -- (DB token -> portal label) so the round-trip is lossless: only the
  -- multi-word labels need explicit remaps; every other label lowercases to its
  -- token ('Data'->'data', 'Finance'->'finance', 'Media'->'media',
  -- 'Other'->'other'). Already-lowercase values (community/MCP) pass through.
  NEW.category := CASE lower(btrim(NEW.category))
    WHEN 'ai & ml'         THEN 'compute'
    WHEN 'geo & maps'      THEN 'location'
    WHEN 'developer tools' THEN 'tools'
    ELSE lower(btrim(NEW.category))
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apiosk_sync_apis_active_with_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'gateway_v2', 'kyb', 'providers', 'catalog', 'actions', 'billing', 'agents', 'wallets', 'research', 'integrations', 'observability', 'support', 'content', 'operations', 'identity', 'extensions', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- status is the source of truth (CHECK status in ('active','inactive')).
  NEW.active := (NEW.status = 'active');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
